the development of a robotic tracking system that can autonomously track an object that moves at different speeds, and is able to track the object in both line of sight and no line of sight environments.

the design, development and evaluation of a robotic tracking and following agent, which is able to track and follow a moving, RF- emitting object, which we call the Leader, using only signal strength information.

a single rotating directional antenna can be used as a sensing modality for autonomous tracking and following of a moving object, which is a novel approach for mobile sensing and tracking.
